extensionDescription.message: Save pages to your Chrome bookmark folders with a keyboard shortcut. Find or create a folder and press Enter. No account.

newFolderDescription.message: In the Bookmarks bar. This page will be saved there.

firstSaveHint.message: Type part of a folder name and press Enter to save this page.

shortcutUnassigned.message: You can assign a keyboard shortcut to open Marky if you like.

shortcutUnknown.message: You can check your shortcut in Chrome settings.

loadError.message: Could not load your bookmark folders. Try again.

saveError.message: Could not save the page. Try again or choose another folder.

settingsError.message: Could not open shortcut settings. Try again.

unsupportedPage.message: Marky cannot save this Chrome service page. Open a website and try again.

missingPage.message: The page address is unavailable. Open a website and reopen Marky.
